subject: "Error: Frequencies must be on the right of the data matrix." when using fscores() with EAPsum

messages.author: fce58c3d4618fa13
messages.subject: "Error: Frequencies must be on the right of the data matrix." when using fscores() with EAPsum
parts:
Hi, 

I've been getting the following error:

> fscores(expmodeldiff, method = "EAPsum", full.scores = F, na.rm = T)
Error: Frequencies must be on the right of the data matrix.

...the model is a MultiGroupClass, but this happens also with SingleGroupClass. I do not have the full range of the possible sum scores in my data, so that's my best guess. Other methods within fscores() work as expected. Sorry for not providing a reproducible code at the moment. 

Thanks,
Best,
Adam

messages.author: fce58c3d4618fa13
messages.subject: Re: "Error: Frequencies must be on the right of the data matrix." when using fscores() with EAPsum
parts:
Sorry, Phil, I was just wondering if *maybe* this was an error commonly associated with a known issue. 

Here is my code. 

expmodeldiff <- multipleGroup(data = MIRTdata[,3:49], model = 1, itemtype = 'Rasch', SE = T,
                                technical = list(NCYCLES = 2000, removeEmptyRows = T), group = as.character(MIRTdata$Rocnik), method = "EM",
                                invariance = c("free_means", "free_var", "slopes", "intercepts"))
fscores(expmodeldiff, method = "EAPsum", full.scores = F, na.rm = T)

Find the R object with MIRTdata datafile attached. The fscores() function works fine when full.scores = T and also when method is different (e.g., MAP or EAP).
